items.question: What enduring weighty steadiness characterizes the goddess’s form in contrast to lightness?
premises: The goddess’s form is described as heavy and steady.
This characterization is emphatically repeated four times.
Weighty steadiness stands in contrast to the state of lightness mentioned previously.
items.inference: The goddess’s nature is firmly established as enduringly weighty and unwavering.
uncertainties: Whether guru here carries only the sense of heaviness or also evokes the guru principle remains contextually open.
items.plain_english: Heavy and steady, heavy and steady, heavy and steady, heavy and steady.
